payload.content: When the question asks for the difference between two dates (in days, age, elapsed time), use `JULIANDAY(date_a) - JULIANDAY(date_b)` rather than subtracting the columns directly. SQLite does not support `date_a - date_b` arithmetic on TEXT date columns.

rationale: gepa_decompose: substitutes JULIANDAY for naive date subtraction; tests whether promoting the canonical SQLite date-diff idiom into the active candidate set lifts execution accuracy.
